admin_head: 60 - Ministère du Développement Numérique, des Postes et des Télécommunications
spending_entity: Ministère du Développement Numérique, des Postes et des Télécommunications
purpose: Runs and coordinates the ministry's digital transformation programme.
scope_basis: The objective sits inside programme 662 Transformation Numérique, whose stated purpose is digital, and is the whole of that programme apart from its separately printed postal objective. It is scored partial because the objective's own purpose is administration and coordination rather than a delivery activity, and two thirds of it is the payroll of a ministry that also runs posts and telecommunications, which the document does not split.
amount_scale: thousands of ariary as printed - every table is headed *En Milliers d'Ariary* - stored here normalised to units
doc_locator: LFR 2026 (Loi n° 2026-004), Tome 2 Livre 1 *Document budgétaire*, PDF p. 73, *Prévision Dépenses*, ministère 60, programme 662 Transformation Numérique, objectif 078 Administration et Coordination
notes: Thousands as printed: LFI 2026 7,555,595 and LFR 2026 10,989,127. Cross-foots twice - the revised figure is soldes 7,266,625 plus hors-soldes 2,722,502 plus investissement 1,000,000, and objectif 078 plus the postal objectif 214 (62,000) is programme 662's printed 11,051,127. Financement Intérieur / 10 RPI on every line, so the origin gate passes it whole.
